-For my mahal

I really don't know if there's a perfect way to put everything I feel for you into words. Baka hindi sapat ang simpleng “I love you” para maipaliwanag kung gaano kita kamahal at kung gaano ka kahalaga sa akin.

Before you came into my life, I never really understood how it feels to be loved in a way that makes you feel safe, cared for, and appreciated. Pero nung dumating ka, unti-unti kong naramdaman kung gaano kasarap sa pakiramdam ang magkaroon ng taong totoong nagmamahal at gustong-gustong akong makitang masaya at okay. And that's exactly what you gave me.

You've always been so caring and sweet to me. Palagi mong sinisigurado na okay ako, maayos ako. At never kang nagkulang iparamdam kung gaano mo ako kamahal. I appreciate how you never get tired of loving me and understanding me, my Mahal/Prinsesa.

I know there are times that we're not okay. Ang dami na nating pinag-awayan, maraming beses na tayong hindi nagkaintindihan. But still, we choose to fix it. We give each other chances.

Even on days when I'm not easy to understand, you still choose to be patient with me. You still stay. You still try. At sobrang thankful ako roon, Mahal. Ang totoong pagmamahal pala ay pagpiling manatili kahit wala tayong lahat ng sagot, kahit nakakapagod.

Also, I hope you know that I notice all the little things you do for me. The way you take care of me as always. And I really appreciate the way you changed yourself for me, for us. Para lang hindi masira ang relationship natin. I know that you did your best to be better for me and us.

Gusto ko ring malaman mo na sobrang proud ako sa'yo, as always, mahal. Nakikita ko lahat ng effort mo at pagpapakahirap mo para sa mga pangarap mo at para sa ating dalawa. Seeing how dedicated you are makes me respect you even more, at sobrang nae-excite ako sa future natin. I hope we both become successful someday.

Kahit anong mangyari sa atin sa mga susunod na araw o taon, gusto ko sabay nating harapin lahat. Through every high and low, I will always be right here cheering for you, supporting you, and loving you with all my heart.

Mahal na mahal kita palagi, my MAHAL/PRINSESA.
